name: Being Delayed
overview: Scripture teaches that delays in God's timing are purposeful and filled with hope. Though the vision or promise may tarry, believers are called to wait patiently, trusting that God will surely fulfill His word (Habakkuk 2:3). In times of hardship or famine, like the days of the judges, God’s comfort and restoration are assured (Ruth 1:1; Isaiah 40:1; Joel 2:25). His will is to increase and bless His people, and His law is deeply cherished within the heart of the faithful (Psalms 40:8; Psalms 115:14).
